boxes.text:
[useAgentCanvasBridge]
stable workspace identity + ephemeral canvasId
register --> poll commands --> handle --> reply
non-context results cached by command ID; live selections via WebSocket

[MappingPage.handleAgentCommand]
context / document-state / snapshot --> controller read projections
apply(requestId, expectedVersion, operations) --> receipt deduplication
apply-diagram-revision --> revisionReceiver --> sync + storage.flush
create-document / copy-document --> CanvasWorkspace sessions

[MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate / transact]
version check --> 1-100 operations --> clone staged document + canvas

diagram-create / insert / replace / patch / mappings / jumps
DiagramService --> issued Diagram + node correspondence
patch --> rebase anchors / jumps / folds / sections
grid move / collapse / group / remove --> layoutScene

subtree collapse --> revision-scoped diagramViews
missing node --> STALE_CONTENT_NODE

floating move / collapse / remove --> DisplayState
pixel move selects manual placement; arrows follow anchors

[updateSnapshot(record=true)]
reconcile connections + jumps; normalize folds + selection focus
resolve floating geometry; validate connections
append(document, canvas, node correspondence) --> history checkpoint
publish snapshot + version + undo/redo flags --> subscribers

[CanvasSession publications]
document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry / status
select(command) records; updateCanvas defaults to transient
layout and endpoint measurements update runtime geometry
